## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle late-Míng sub-commentary by [明昱](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E6%98%B1) **Gāoyuán Míngyù** on Pǔtài's [KR6n0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0131) *Bā shí guījǔ bǔzhù*. Preserved in the *Manji Xuzangjing* 卍續藏 at X55n0890. The function-marker *zhèngyì* 證義 ("doctrinal verification") indicates a sub-commentary that *verifies* (in both the assertive and the philological senses) Pǔtài's doctrinal positions, citing supporting authority from the broader Cí'ēn-school corpus.

**Abstract**

The *Zhèngyì* tracks Pǔtài's *Bǔzhù* verse by verse, supplying additional doctrinal authority from the *Chéng wéishí lùn*, the *Yújiā shīdì lùn*, and the standard Cí'ēn-school glossary. Where Pǔtài's interpretation could be read in more than one way, Míngyù argues for the philologically more conservative and Cí'ēn-orthodox reading. The work is a key witness to Míngyù's principal late-Míng Yogācāra philological project: re-establishing the strict Cí'ēn-school reading of the *guījǔ* tradition as against the more ecumenical readings being developed in parallel by Hānshān ([KR6n0135](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0135)) and Zhìxù ([KR6n0137](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0137)).

The dating window 1590–1620 brackets Míngyù's productive Wànlì period.
